why: No check sets initial on a select or multiselect prompt; initial checks are confirm and text only.
Shift-click on empty canvas only; no click on an element inside a selected one.
Single-element stats check does not name a line or arrow.
Token-mismatch confirmation check exists but nothing opens the link in a background tab.
0.5px editor width appears only for Firefox and Safari; no Chrome check.
BORDERLINE (same standard as smoke and control): check that a pointer within 1.5 focus-point sizes of an endpoint can begin dragging it; none says inside-bound endpoint.
Edge-touch checks; no rectangle fully containing a frame.
Encoding checks use uppercase escapes and raw characters; no lowercase %2f input.
Bare-flag checks use an empty string; no numeric 0 value.
